model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в абсолютната средна стойност на скритото състояние (Hidden State Mean) през различните слоеве на модел, като сравнява три различни величини. Оста X е обозначена като „Layer", използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23 и етикетите са разположени през равни интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Abs Mean", също с линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 4.5, с етикети през интервали от 1.0 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4).

Първата линия, представена в син цвят с пунктиран стил (dashed), съответства на „hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Тя започва от стойност близо до 0.1 при слой 0, леко нараства до около 0.25 при слоеве 2–3, след което леко спада и се задържа около 0.2 в диапазона от слой 4 до слой 9. От слой 10 нататък линията започва постепенно да нараства, достигайки около 0.5 при слой 16–17, след което нарастването рязко се ускорява — стойността достига приблизително 0.9 при слой 20, около 2.6 при слой 22 и завършва с ясно изразен връх от приблизително 4.4 при последния слой (около 23).

Втората линия, представена в оранжев цвят с точков (dotted) стил, съответства на „hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Тя остава много близо до 0 през целия диапазон на оста X, без видими значителни отклонения, като стойностите ѝ са трудно различими от нулата на тази скала.

Третата линия, представена в зелен цвят с плътен (solid) стил, съответства на „hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Подобно на оранжевата линия, тя също се задържа много близо до 0 през всички слоеве, с минимално нарастване към последните слоеве, достигайки стойност от приблизително 0.1 при слой 23.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across network layers for three different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with major tick marks at intervals of 1.0 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). The first line, shown as a blue dashed line, represents "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; it starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.25 by layer 2, remains relatively flat between approximately 0.2 and 0.3 through layers 3 to 10, then gradually increases through the middle layers reaching roughly 0.5 around layer 17, before rising sharply from about 0.9 at layer 20 to a peak of approximately 4.5 at layer 23. The second line, shown as an orange dotted line, represents "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; it remains very close to zero throughout all layers, staying nearly flat and barely distinguishable from the baseline, with values appearing to be at or just above 0.05 across the entire range. The third line, shown as a green solid line, represents "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; it similarly stays very close to zero across all layers, with a very slight increase toward the final layers reaching approximately 0.08 by layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across network layers for three different conditions. The x-axis represents "Layer," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Abs Mean," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick labels at intervals of 1.0.

The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style, represents "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71." It starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.25 by layer 2, then remains relatively steady between approximately 0.2 and 0.3 through layers 3 to 10. From layer 10 onward, it begins increasing more noticeably, reaching approximately 0.5 around layer 15, then accelerating sharply after layer 18, climbing to roughly 0.9 at layer 20, approximately 2.6 at layer 22, and peaking near 4.4 at layer 23 before slightly declining to around 2.5 at the final layer. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05." It remains very close to 0 throughout all layers, with only minimal variation, staying below approximately 0.1 across the entire range. The third line, shown in green with a solid line style, represents "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." It similarly remains very close to 0 across all layers, largely overlapping with the orange line, and stays below approximately 0.1 throughout.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm mit dem Titel „Hidden State Mean" stellt die absolute mittlere Aktivierung verborgener Zustände über die Schichten eines Modells hinweg dar, wobei drei verschiedene Bedingungen verglichen werden. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Abständen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen bei 0, 1, 2, 3 und 4. Die erste Linie, dargestellt als blaue gestrichelte Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei einem Wert nahe 0,1, steigt leicht auf etwa 0,25 bei Layer 2–3, bleibt dann relativ stabil zwischen 0,2 und 0,3 bis etwa Layer 10, steigt danach allmählich auf etwa 0,5 bei Layer 15 und 0,9 bei Layer 20, bevor sie steil ansteigt und bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 4,4 erreicht. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt als orange gepunktete Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Sie verläuft nahezu flach entlang der Nulllinie über alle Schichten hinweg, mit Werten, die durchgehend nahe 0 bleiben und nur minimal auf etwa 0,1 bei den letzten Schichten ansteigen. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt als grüne durchgezogene Linie, repräsentiert „hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Auch sie verläuft nahezu flach nahe 0 über den gesamten Schichtbereich, mit einem leichten Anstieg auf etwa 0,08 bei den letzten Schichten.
